title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Regulations for All General Degree with Major Programs
All
students
graduating with general
programs
with major are subject to the following regulations:
A general degree program with major must consist of a minimum of 15.0 credits, including at
least 5.0
senior
credits in the major. Individual
departments
may require more than this
minimum.
Students completing Options and Minors must satisfy the graduation requirements for those
programs.
Any exceptions to the general degree with major regulations require the approval of both the
department and the dean (or designate). Exceptions that would make the number of credits required for
graduation fewer than 15.0 are not permitted.
(Note: honours degrees will not recognize unsuccessful
attempts
at honours subjects taken in
combination: students in a combined honours program who are unsuccessful in meeting the
GPA
requirements of one of their honours subjects do not have the option of receiving a degree which
certifies completion of a single honours subject and a "general-level" major.)
